frozenQuestion: Do the six no-fault n=100 reference conditions reach the reported sorted endpoint and reproduce the qualitative Figure 3 trajectories, and how does the frozen public cell-view comparator differ where it is executable?

paperScale.conditions: all six unique_1_100, no-fault, pure-policy cell-view/traditional profiles

confirmatory.conditions: the same six unique_1_100 no-fault pure-policy profiles; historical execution is limited to the three cell-view profiles present in C

protectedSplitGate.unlockRule: The confirmatory runner must receive the SHA-256 of this exact canonical JSON file and must reject every split or condition outside the declared population.
protectedSplitGate.exclusions: None. Every intended run, timeout, error, censoring event, and terminal reason remains in accounting.

outcomes.primaryEndpoint: strict all-run completion with final non-strict ascending order and 100 percent paper Sortedness
outcomes.trajectoryAxis: successful-swap index for Figure 3; 201-point normalized successful-swap progress for paired trajectory contrasts
outcomes.sortedness: 100 * count(i == 0 or value[i] > value[i-1]) / n; valid here because all values are unique
outcomes.trajectoryDistance: trapezoidal integrated absolute cell-view minus traditional Sortedness gap over normalized swap progress, in percentage points
outcomes.selectionBurden: paired accepted-swap difference and ratio, cell-view minus/over traditional
outcomes.stopping: S03 reference completion/quiescence/event-budget semantics; C historical is_sorted with an adapter safety timeout that is never reclassified as a historical stop rule

claimRules.allEndpoints: supportive only if every reference run completes, has final Sortedness 100, conserves the value multiset, and has no unexplained terminal state
claimRules.bubbleTrajectoryDifference: supportive if the multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence limit for mean paired trajectory distance exceeds 5 percentage points
claimRules.insertionTrajectorySimilarity: supportive if the multiplicity-adjusted upper confidence limit for mean paired trajectory distance is below the 5 percentage-point equivalence margin
claimRules.selectionSwapBurden: supportive if the multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence limit for paired cell-view minus traditional accepted swaps is above zero

uncertainty.completion: two-sided 95 percent Wilson interval plus strict all-run criterion
uncertainty.pairedContrasts: 10000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples; both 95 percent intervals and Bonferroni family-adjusted 98.75 percent intervals for the endpoint, Bubble-shape, Insertion-similarity, and Selection-swap Figure 3 claim families
uncertainty.trajectoryEnvelope: run-level mean, standard-error 95 percent interval, and empirical 2.5/97.5 percent run envelope at each normalized grid point

traceAndReplaySampling.rule: Within each backend-eligible condition and split, select the lexicographically smallest scenarioId before outcomes are run.
traceAndReplaySampling.paperTrajectories: retain every paper-scale derived successful-swap Sortedness trajectory needed for the 100-line reconstruction; these are not activation traces
traceAndReplaySampling.confirmatoryTrajectories: retain 201-point summary grids for all runs and raw derived successful-swap trajectories only for the preselected scenarios, failures, or anomalies
traceAndReplaySampling.exactReplay: run each of the 12 selected reference scenarios twice through the ordinary digest-emitting engine and require byte-exact equality plus equality with the summary-only transition path
traceAndReplaySampling.historicalReplay: do not demand exact replay from the thread scheduler; repeat the three selected paper-scale C scenarios five times as a separate variability diagnostic

historicalBoundary.wallClock: descriptive only; thread scheduling and host load make it non-portable and there is no scheduler-independent historical time axis
